text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا

translations.asad: CONSIDER the sun and its radiant brightness,
translations.sahih: By the sun and its brightness

translations.asad: and the moon as it reflects the sun!
translations.sahih: And [by] the moon when it follows it

translations.asad: Consider the day as it reveals the world,
translations.sahih: And [by] the day when it displays it

translations.asad: and the night as it veils it darkly!
translations.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers it

translations.asad: Consider the sky and its wondrous make,
translations.sahih: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

translations.asad: and the earth and all its expanse!
translations.sahih: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

translations.asad: Consider the human self, and how it is formed in accordance with what it is meant to be,
translations.sahih: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

translations.asad: and how it is imbued with moral failings as well as with consciousness of God!
translations.sahih: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

translations.asad: To a happy state shall indeed attain he who causes this [self] to grow in purity,
translations.sahih: He has succeeded who purifies it,

translations.asad: and truly lost is he who buries it [in darkness].
translations.sahih: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

translations.asad: TO [THIS] TRUTH gave the lie, in their overweening arrogance, [the tribe of] Thamud,
translations.sahih: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

translations.asad: when that most hapless wretch from among them rushed forward [to commit his evil deed],
translations.sahih: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

text.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا

translations.asad: although God's apostle had told them, "It is a she-camel belonging to God, so let her drink [and do her no harm]!"
translations.sahih: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."

text.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

translations.asad: But they gave him the lie, and cruelly slaughtered her - whereupon their Sustainer visited them with utter destruction for this their sin, destroying them all alike:
translations.sahih: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].

translations.asad: for none [of them] had any fear of what might befall them.
translations.sahih: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
